title: Agentic EEG Decoder: analysis code for EEG cognitive-workload decoding, cross-dataset transfer, and a graded workload index
description:
Analysis code accompanying two studies of EEG cognitive-workload decoding: a multi-specialist stacking decoder with a decomposition of cross-dataset transfer (Intelligent Automation & Soft Computing 41(1):27-46, 2026, doi:10.32604/iasc.2026.088039) and a graded workload index evaluated on a 14-channel consumer montage (manuscript under review).

Includes preprocessing, feature extraction, decoders, multi-seed statistics with false-discovery-rate control, a foundation-model baseline, and cross-device analyses on public datasets (COG-BCI, STEW, EEGMAT, ds003838). Raw EEG is not redistributed.

Data integrity: the public COG-BCI release contains participant IDs with byte-identical EEG (sub-17 to sub-24 and sub-27 in every session; sub-25 and sub-28 in session S1). The tool tools/verify_cogbci_duplicates.py detects these; analyses of the graded index use the 20 participants that share no recording.
